title: A push whose new commits hold a merge with more than two parents is refused before it leaves, or the silent-undo check reads it pairwise
why: Lane record-after-each-round (session_013NEJL3gDkEvHawhJUPygWa, PR #1908), 18:46 CST Nov 8: the lane joined a replay to two old heads with one three-parent `git commit-tree` and pushed it (333c91a6f). lint/check_silent_undo.py line 388 reads only two-parent merges and answers UNKNOWN, so the lane lint fails, and the merge stays in main..head, so only a history rewrite or a new PR clears it.
note: Two fix shapes: the push guard refuses new commits with more than two parents, or check_silent_undo reads an octopus merge as pairwise merges. The lane proposed `step:refuse-octopus-merge-push`. The coordinator routes it. Routed by the coordinator 18:48 CST Nov 8. The lane reads #2339 first; if #2339 already makes check_silent_undo judge octopus merges, the step may close. #2339 merged in batch 67 (#2397, 81a720c42, 03:37 CST Nov 9); the lane checks whether it already judges octopus merges, and if so the step closes. Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane (was session_013NEJKzvB3W9ncBB7N3RBEo).
